facts.value: The source defines two initialized MotionState arrays: ftData_MotionStateList[ftCo_MS_Count], with common state indices 0–340, and ftData_803C52A0[14]. Their records contain animation identity, motion flags, packed move metadata, and five callback slots for animation, input, physics, collision and camera processing. Source declarations and initializer order alone do not establish compiled section contiguity, byte extent or record ABI size.
facts.rationale: Preserves the supported descriptor structure while removing the unsupported assertion of a contiguous 11,360-byte compiled section and 32-byte ABI records.
